M_API_HEADERS,

 -h, --help display help for command

Ac
count:\n login [options] Log in to MCPJam Cloud. Opens your browser for\n OAuth and
stores the session locally.\n logout Remove the stored MCPJam Cloud login.\n whoami
Show the MCPJam Cloud account behind the current\n credentials.\n status
Show how this CLI would authenticate and which\n Cloud project it would use, without calling the\n
network.\n link [options] [project] Pin this directory to a Cloud project by writing\n
.mcpjam/project.json. The file contains no\n secrets and is committed by d

efault;
 per-developer setups may gitignore it.

Workspace:
 organizations|orgs Ins
pect the MCPJam organizations you belong to\n projects Operate the MCP servers saved in your hosted\n
MCPJam projects\n sessions List Playground chat sessions, or search\n
conversations across Playground, user testing,\n evals and swarms.\n tunnel [opt
ions] [target...] Expose a local MCP server through an MCPJam\n tunnel and register it as a server

in your
 project

Eval and environments:
 eval Author and run eval s
uites in your hosted MCPJam\n projects\n clients|hosts List, create, and manage th
e clients in your\n hosted MCPJam projects\n environments List, create, and manag
e the project\n environments (host + servers + pinned\n skills/plugi
ns) in your hosted MCPJam projects\n secrets Store and manage the project credentials a\n
workflow needs (stripe, gh, psql). Write-only:\n no command prints a value.\n server
-accounts Manage the accounts a saved server signs in with\n for hosted runs. Write-o
nly: no command prints a\n token.\n images List, build, and manage custom C
omputer sandbox\n images (blueprints) in your hosted MCPJam\n projec
ts\n skills List and read the Cloud Skills in your hosted\n MCPJam projects

(read-only; authoring lives in
 the app)

Conformance:
 conformance Hosted

conformance runs on saved servers: start,
 poll, read failures

Observability:
 trace-destinat
ions|traces Stream an organization's traces to an OTLP/HTTP\n endpoint (Coralogix, Honeycomb, G
rafana, a\n collector). Header values are write-only: no\n command p

rints one.

Swarms and user testing:
 goals|journeys List goals and inspect their runs (the Swarms
product) in your hosted MCPJam projects\n personas The reusable synthetic characters Sw
arms goals\n run as. A persona carries a name, a role and\n behaviou
ral notes; the task lives on each goal.\n swarms Swarm containers group goals authored together\n
and hold their shared execution config. A goal\n does not need one, but a pr
oject authored\n through the app will have them.\n studies|scenarios Publish project e

nvironments as studies, read
 what testers did, and control who can reach them

Support:
 feed
back [options] Send feedback about MCPJam itself (a bug, a\n missing capability, somethi
ng confusing) to the\n MCPJam team. Your text is sent to the MCPJam\n

team, outside your organization, and stored for
 180 days. Requires a signed-in account.
